stepwell-table-after.see: A high-angle view of a tiered sandstone stepwell with green water at the bottom, set inside an oversized square cutout in a sand floor surrounded by three racks of clay pots.
stepwell-table-after.wrong: large rectangular gaps around the sunken stepwell revealing the black void underneath where the floor cutout does not match the structure

walls-pair-after.see: Two modular wall pieces stand side by side on a dark gridded surface, one finished in plain plaster and the other featuring a framed fresco painting.

walls-pair-before.see: Two modular wall segments stand side by side on a dark gridded surface, one plain and the other decorated with a framed fresco mural.

stepwell-low-before.see: An angled perspective view of an ancient tiered stone stepwell with arches and green water, placed directly upon an uninterrupted sand terrain alongside racks of clay pots.
stepwell-low-before.wrong: the sunken stepwell lacks a cutout hole in the sand floor, causing its submerged geometry to clip directly into the solid terrain

mexhouse-table-before.see: A high-angle view of an enclosed rectangular room with frescoed walls, stone pavers, a burning brazier, two chests flanking a chair, pottery, and a curtained doorway.
mexhouse-table-before.wrong: a stray disconnected patch of sand floor tile floats in the upper-left void outside the room

koshido-open.see: An angled view looking into a traditional Japanese room with paper screen walls and light wood flooring through an open front doorway.

koshido-shut.see: An angled view of a traditional Japanese screen room with paper and wood walls, showing a closed slatted wooden door in the front doorway.

ballcourt-table-before.see: An angled view of an outdoor rectangular ballcourt on a strip of dirt flanked by sloped side walls, with missing end walls and a gap in the lower wall.
ballcourt-table-before.wrong: missing wall segments leaving an open gap on one side, and the court floor ends abruptly over the void without end walls

mexhouse-wall-before.see: A close-up view of the exterior frescoed walls of a chamber, featuring decorative wall niches and floral panels with a fabric curtain visible in the doorway beyond.
mexhouse-wall-before.wrong: polygonal clipping and texture distortion along the bottom edges of the decorative wall niches

ballcourt-top-before.see: A top-down view of an incomplete rectangular ballcourt on a dirt strip with sloped side walls, missing its end barriers and with an incomplete lower wall.
ballcourt-top-before.wrong: a missing wall piece leaves a wide gap along the bottom side, and the court has no end walls

mexhouse-table-after.see: A high-angle perspective view of a decorated ancient chamber with painted fresco walls, stone paving, a lit brazier, an ornate chair flanked by chests, and a curtained entrance.
mexhouse-table-after.wrong: a stray disconnected patch of sand floor tile floats in the upper-left void outside the room

stepwell-low-after.see: A perspective view of a tiered sandstone stepwell with arches leading down to green water, positioned inside a square cutout in the sand floor flanked by clay pot stands.
stepwell-low-after.wrong: the square hole cut into the sand floor leaves large open gaps showing the black void underneath around the stepwell

stepwell-table-before.see: A high-angle view of an ancient sandstone stepwell with green pool water, placed atop a solid square sand tile on a black grid alongside three racks of clay pots.
stepwell-table-before.wrong: the sunken stepwell lacks an excavation cutout in the terrain, causing its lower levels to clip directly into the flat sand floor

ballcourt-top-after.see: A top-down view of a fully assembled rectangular ballcourt with sloped side walls, stone end walls, a green center line, and a black ball in the middle.

ballcourt-table-after.see: An angled perspective view of an assembled rectangular ballcourt on sand with sloped side walls, low stone end barriers, a green dividing line, and a central black ball.

mexhouse-wall-after.see: A close-up view of the exterior frescoed walls of an ancient room, showing painted botanical panels, wall niches, and a draped fabric curtain in the doorway.
mexhouse-wall-after.wrong: polygonal clipping and texture distortion along the lower borders of the decorative wall niches
